finding.claim: No test covers the f1 fix: a plain install over an older installed version must exit 1 naming kmctl plugin update, and status must report the installed-version mismatch. r5's test only edits the staged copy, so it passes even if the installed-version check is removed.

fixes.change: A test installs, bumps the CLI version, and checks status reports the installed mismatch with only the update fix, a plain install refuses naming update, and update clears it.
